title: Early Detection and Automated Remediation Advisory for Crop Pest Infestations using Edge AI and Low-Cost Optics
affected_group: Smallholder farmers in drought-prone and delta districts with limited agronomist access
summary: Build a lightweight edge-compatible mobile/IoT scanning solution that identifies pest egg clusters and leaf blights at early onset and provides targeted, regional-language organic/chemical pesticide dosage advice.
context: Fall Armyworm and Pink Bollworm cause over 30% yield loss in cotton and maize before visible damage prompts spraying. Farmers currently over-spray blanket broad-spectrum pesticides, causing soil degradation and financial distress.
constraints: Must work fully offline with on-device quantized model inference (TFLite/ONNX). Sensor/attachment BOM must remain under ₹800. Must support Tamil, Hindi, Telugu, and Marathi audio prompts.
feasibility_notes: Datasets are publicly available from ICAR and PlantVillage. 36-hour prototype can demonstrate smartphone macro-lens capture + quantized MobileNetV4 inference.

sources.name: Smart India Hackathon 2024 Portal (PS ID: 1601)
ICAR Annual Research Report on Crop Protection

hints: Judges look for offline inference speed and realistic dosage recommendations based on acreage, rather than generic bounding-box detection. Highlight regional voice feedback for semi-literate farmers.

previous_prototypes.prototype_summary: Built a basic ResNet50 classifier deployed on a cloud server with Streamlit UI.
previous_prototypes.shortcoming: Failed in real farm tests due to 4G connectivity dropouts in rural fields and lacked actionable remediation dosages.

previous_prototypes.prototype_summary: Raspberry Pi 4 with camera mounted on a stick with local web interface.
previous_prototypes.shortcoming: Hardware BOM cost exceeded ₹6,500, making it unaffordable for individual smallholders; high battery consumption (2.5 hours runtime).

sample_solution_direction: Use a 3D-printed $2 macro optical clip for standard smartphones + quantized MobileNet-EdgeTPU model running in Flutter with local SQLite dosage lookup matrix.

title: Real-time Detection and Volumetric Quantification of Road Potholes and Surface Hazards via Smartphone Dashcam Telemetry
organization: National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) & MoRTH
affected_group: Commuters, state transport bus operators, and municipal highway maintenance contractors
summary: Develop a crowd-sourced mobile vision and accelerometer system that detects potholes, estimates their depth and cubic repair volume, and generates geotagged priority repair tickets for municipal corporations.
context: Pothole-related road accidents claimed over 4,000 lives annually in India. Current road inspections are periodic, manual, subjective, and prone to contractor dispute. NHAI requires automated surface distress profiling.
constraints: Zero dedicated hardware sensors beyond ordinary driver smartphones mounted on dashboards. Must filter out vehicle vibration anomalies from speed breakers vs actual potholes. Strict privacy: blur all license plates and pedestrian faces on-device before sync.
feasibility_notes: High feasibility for hackathons. Teams can collect a small validation video sample around campus roads and demonstrate real-time bounding box + accelerometer bump sync.

sources.name: SIH 2024 MoRTH Challenge Track
NHAI Road Safety Annual Audit

hints: Key differentiator is the sensor fusion: coupling IMU z-axis acceleration spikes with optical optical-flow bounding boxes. Pure vision fails in night or waterlogged potholes.

previous_prototypes.prototype_summary: YOLOv5 trained on open dataset running on laptop recording webcam.
previous_prototypes.shortcoming: Could not calculate depth or repair volume. Suffered false positives from shadows and lane markings.

sample_solution_direction: Dual-stream Kalman filter fusing accelerometer z-variance with YOLOv8-nano optical bbox to compute rough polygon area and volumetric asphalt ton required.

title: Decentralized Verification and Cold-Chain Integrity Monitoring for Primary Healthcare Vaccines and Insulin
affected_group: Rural Primary Health Centres (PHCs), ASHA workers, and child immunization recipients
summary: A tamper-evident, low-cost BLE temperature data logger coupled with a cryptographic ledger verifying that temperature-sensitive vaccines remained between 2°C and 8°C throughout transit from district depots to village camps.
context: Up to 25% of vaccines in tropical states lose potency during the last-mile ice-box transit due to melted coolant packs, with no automated log proving whether the cold chain was maintained.
constraints: Total tag cost must be under ₹350 ($4). Battery must survive 45 days. Must synchronize with ASHA worker's ANM-OL smartphone app via offline BLE beacon broadcasts.
feasibility_notes: Hardware team can simulate BLE temperature packets with ESP32-C3 while software team builds the mobile verifier and hash checkpoint viewer.

sources.name: National Health Mission - Cold Chain Guidelines
SIH 2024 Health Informatics Track

hints: Do not build a slow public Ethereum blockchain. Use lightweight cryptographic hash chains (Merkle trees) stamped to a verifiable state channel or Hyperledger Besu instance.

previous_prototypes.prototype_summary: Arduino Uno with GSM SIM800 module transmitting temperature via HTTP every 5 minutes.
previous_prototypes.shortcoming: Device consumed too much power (died in 4 hours), required expensive SIM cards in each vial box, and was too bulky for vaccine carriers.

sample_solution_direction: Use ultra-low power nRF52840 broadcasting encrypted periodic beacon advertisements, logged by receiving smartphones without active pairing.

title: Automated AI-assisted Triage and Sign-Language Translation for Emergency Room and Telemedicine Consultations
organization: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment / AICTE
affected_group: Deaf and hard-of-hearing patients in emergency triage and rural telemedicine booths
summary: Real-time, bidirectional Indian Sign Language (ISL) translator running in the browser using MediaPipe hand/pose mesh and lightweight transformers, coupled with emergency symptom triage.
context: Over 18 million speech and hearing-impaired citizens in India face catastrophic communication barriers in emergency medical centers where trained ISL interpreters are unavailable.
constraints: Must achieve sub-300ms latency on mid-range laptops/tablets without requiring external GPUs. Must support bidirectional: ISL gestures to speech, and doctor's voice to 3D avatar animations.
feasibility_notes: Scope down for 36-hour hackathon to 40 core medical emergency signs (e.g. chest pain, breathing difficulty, bleeding, allergies, pain scale 1-10) rather than full dictionary.

sources.name: Indian Sign Language Research and Training Centre (ISLRTC)

hints: Judges reward end-to-end flow: deaf patient gestures -> live text & voice synthesis -> doctor answers -> animated avatar signs back -> medical triage card generated.

previous_prototypes.prototype_summary: Static image classification of single hand alphabets A-Z using CNN.
previous_prototypes.shortcoming: Real ISL uses dynamic motion gestures and two hands, not isolated finger-spelling. Alphabet spelling is unusable during heart attack or trauma.

sample_solution_direction: MediaPipe holistic tracking + temporal GRU or light Transformer on normalized landmark coordinate streams.

title: Micro-Grid Energy Orchestration and Peer-to-Peer Solar Trading for Rural Educational Institutions
organization: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
affected_group: Rural schools, colleges, and adjacent farming borewells with rooftop solar installations
summary: An intelligent load-scheduling and virtual microgrid platform that forecasts institutional solar generation and directs excess surplus power to agricultural cold storage or local grid with automated settlement.
context: Colleges and schools generate massive solar power on weekends and vacations which gets wasted or curtailed due to net-metering tariff disincentives, while neighboring farming pumps suffer load shedding.
constraints: Integration with existing modbus/RS485 energy meters or smart inverter APIs. Predictive algorithm must account for regional weather forecast and historical consumption.
feasibility_notes: Great project for beginner to intermediate teams. Can simulate solar generation data using historical solar radiation datasets (NSRDB) and show real-time dynamic switching.

sources.name: MNRE Rooftop Solar Scheme Documentation

hints: Simulate a live dashboard showing 3 campuses and 2 cold storage units with automated load dispatching whenever battery charges above 85%.

previous_prototypes.prototype_summary: Basic web dashboard displaying simulated meter readings.
previous_prototypes.shortcoming: Had zero predictive intelligence. Only showed historical graphs without automated dispatch decisions.

sample_solution_direction: FastAPI backend with LightGBM hourly solar irradiation forecaster + rule engine assigning surplus electricity via priority queue to agro-coolers.

title: Low-Cost Acoustic and Pressure Wave Pipeline Leak and Contamination Detector for Jal Jeevan Mission
affected_group: Rural village water supply committees and municipal pipe network maintenance staff
summary: Non-invasive acoustic clamp-on sensor unit that analyzes pipe frequency harmonics to detect pinhole leaks, non-revenue water loss, and backflow contamination in drinking water lines.
context: Over 35% of treated drinking water distributed under the Jal Jeevan Mission is lost in underground distribution pipelines before reaching tap connections, while cracked pipes suck in septic runoff during pressure drops.
constraints: Sensor node must be non-intrusive (no cutting pipes). Cost under ₹1,200 per node. LoRaWAN transmission for 5km rural range without GSM dependency.
feasibility_notes: Hackathon demo can use a PVC pipe with small water pump, piezoceramic disc sensor, and ESP32 streaming FFT data to a web map.

sources.name: Jal Jeevan Mission Guidelines & Technical Specifications

hints: Highlight how acoustic wave propagation velocity identifies the exact leak position (within 2 meters) along a 50m pipe segment using cross-correlation between two nodes.

previous_prototypes.prototype_summary: Ultrasonic flow meter installed inside the pipe line.
previous_prototypes.shortcoming: Required municipal plumbers to cut active pipe sections, risking contamination and voiding pipe manufacturer warranties.

sample_solution_direction: Clamp-on piezoelectric contact microphone + ESP32 calculating Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) peak shift, transmitting anomalies over LoRaWAN.

title: Offline-First Interactive Gamified STEM Learning Platform for Multi-Grade Classrooms in Tribal Schools
organization: Ministry of Tribal Affairs & Ministry of Education
affected_group: First-generation tribal learners in Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRS) and single-teacher schools
summary: An ultra-lightweight, zero-internet gamified science and math mastery app that runs on refurbished low-spec Android tablets with peer-to-peer Wi-Fi mesh sync for homework and teacher assessments.
context: Internet connectivity in remote hilly and tribal settlements is erratic or non-existent. Students cannot use cloud-dependent EdTech apps like Khan Academy or Byju's.
constraints: Zero cellular data requirement during school hours. Must function on Android 8.0 devices with 1.5GB RAM. Assets must be compressed under 40MB total. Culturally relevant folklore characters.
feasibility_notes: Ideal for beginner student teams! Building a clean, delightful offline PWA with local SQLite/IndexedDB and Wi-Fi Direct sync can be completed cleanly in 36 hours.

sources.name: Ministry of Tribal Affairs EMRS Portal

hints: Demonstrate the peer-to-peer local sync: when one teacher's phone enters a cellular zone once a week, it uploads the aggregated progress batch.

previous_prototypes.prototype_summary: React Native app with video lectures.
previous_prototypes.shortcoming: App weighed 450MB and required streaming videos from AWS S3, instantly crashing when internet dropped.

sample_solution_direction: Progressive Web App built with Tailwind and lightweight Canvas animations, storing game states in RxDB/IndexedDB and syncing via Wi-Fi hotspot sync.

title: Automated AI Forensic Tool for Deepfake Voice Clones and Audio Spoofing in Financial Social Engineering Scams
organization: Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C) & MHA
affected_group: Elderly citizens, bank customers, and emergency financial contact respondents
summary: Real-time acoustic spectral analysis model running on mobile or PBX gateways that detects synthetic AI voice clones (ElevenLabs/VALL-E) and warns users during incoming fraud calls.
context: Scammers are calling parents with voice clones of their children pleading for urgent bail or hospital money. Over ₹1,200 Crores was lost in digital arrest and spoofed voice scams in 2024-2025.
constraints: Inference within 2.5 seconds of phone call audio snippet. Must analyze phase continuity and breathing artifacts without access to original reference voices.
feasibility_notes: Students can train or fine-tune a lightweight CNN on the ASVspoof 2021 dataset and build a web-based demo where users speak vs play an ElevenLabs cloned sample.

sources.name: I4C National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal Advisory

hints: Judges want to see visual proof of detection: spectrogram comparisons showing unnatural spectral cutoffs and lack of biological glottal pulse jitter in synthetic speech.

previous_prototypes.prototype_summary: Cloud API checking audio files uploaded via a web form.
previous_prototypes.shortcoming: Latency was 14 seconds—unusable during an ongoing active phone scam call.

sample_solution_direction: Biquad filter + Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC) feature extraction fed to a quantized MobileNetV3 1D-spectrogram classifier.

title: Real-time Non-Invasive EEG Signal Decoding for Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) Assistive Communication
organization: Shaastra IIT Madras & Centre for Brain Research (NeuroHack)
affected_group: ALS, locked-in syndrome, and severe motor-neuron disorder patients
summary: Develop an ultra-low-latency on-device signal processing and neural network pipeline that decodes 8-channel EEG motor-imagery signals into alphanumeric text and robotic wheelchair steering prompts.
context: Traditional motor-imagery BCI systems suffer from high inter-session signal drift and latency exceeding 600ms. Patients require reliable assistive typing without exhausting recalibration routines.
constraints: Must infer under 120ms per epoch on standard x86/ARM hardware. Artifact filtering must eliminate ocular blinks (EOG) and jaw clenches (EMG). Open-source BCI hardware (OpenBCI Cyton) compatible.
feasibility_notes: PhysioNet EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Dataset and BCI Competition IV datasets are publicly available. 36-hr prototype can demonstrate live simulated stream playback + real-time classification.

sources.name: Shaastra NeuroHack Problem Statement Guidelines
PhysioNet EEG Motor Movement Database

hints: Judges prioritize artifact suppression algorithms (ICA/CSP) and transfer learning across subjects over complex transformer models with excessive compute overhead.

previous_prototypes.prototype_summary: EEG classifier using 1D-CNN hosted on cloud Flask server.
previous_prototypes.shortcoming: Cloud latency reached 850ms making typing frustrating; lacked subject-adaptation.

sample_solution_direction: Combine Common Spatial Patterns (CSP) spatial filtering with a lightweight EEGNet architecture running quantized ONNX on local device.

title: Autonomous 3D LiDAR-Inertial SLAM and Dynamic Obstacle Avoidance for Industrial AGVs in GPS-Denied Warehouses
organization: Caterpillar Inc. & Shaastra Autonomous Systems Lab
affected_group: Factory floor workers, logistics operators, and heavy machinery facilities
summary: Engineer an onboard sensor fusion pipeline combining 3D LiDAR point clouds and 6-DOF IMU telemetry to achieve centimeter-accurate mapping and real-time obstacle avoidance around moving forklifts and personnel.
context: GPS signals cannot penetrate steel-reinforced warehouse structures. Traditional 2D LiDAR fails when pallets or reflective shrink-wraps distort 2D planar scans, leading to AGV route aborts.
constraints: Must operate in real-time at >= 15Hz on an embedded compute unit (NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano). Maximum localization drift under 3cm per 100 meters traveled.
feasibility_notes: Simulated warehouse world models in Gazebo are readily available. Participants can benchmark FAST-LIO2 or LIO-SAM against simulated ground truth.

sources.name: Caterpillar Autonomy Challenge Problem Archive
IEEE Robotics and Automation Society

hints: Focus on graceful degradation during degenerate geometries (long narrow featureless corridors). Implement adaptive costmaps.

previous_prototypes.prototype_summary: Cartographer 2D SLAM running on Raspberry Pi 4.
previous_prototypes.shortcoming: Lost tracking completely when turning corners around stacked pallets; high computational lag.

sample_solution_direction: Implement an iterated error-state Kalman filter (FAST-LIO2) with OctoMap dynamic voxel filtering and Nav2 trajectory controllers in ROS 2.

title: Decentralized Acoustic Pipeline Leak Localization and Autonomous Pressure Regulation for Municipal Water Grids
organization: Shaastra Future Cities & Chennai Metropolitan Water Supply
affected_group: Metro water authorities, urban residents facing non-revenue water loss (NRW)
summary: Deploy low-cost hydrophone acoustic edge nodes to detect underground micro-bursts and cavitation anomalies in distribution lines before sinkhole formation occurs.
context: Indian metropolitan cities lose between 35% to 45% of treated drinking water to hidden underground leaks. Current manual acoustic correlators are labor-intensive and only deployed after major surfacing leaks.
constraints: Node BOM must remain under ₹1,200. Battery life minimum 18 months via solar trickle. Wireless telemetry via LoRaWAN up to 3km radius.
feasibility_notes: Synthesized acoustic water pipe leak frequency datasets (hydrophone recordings at 50Hz-2kHz) are accessible for rapid model training.

sources.name: Shaastra IndustriAI Research & Future Cities Summit
Jal Jeevan Mission Technical Manual on Smart Water Grids

hints: Focus on cross-correlation delay estimation between two adjacent pipe nodes to pinpoint leak coordinates to within 1.5 meters.

previous_prototypes.prototype_summary: GSM-based pressure sensor logging to Google Sheets.
previous_prototypes.shortcoming: GSM module drained 12V lead-acid battery within 3 weeks; pressure thresholding generated 60% false alarms during normal valve cycling.

sample_solution_direction: Piezoelectric contact microphone + TinyML 1D convolutional spectrogram classifier on ESP32-S3 reporting anomalous energy bands via LoRaWAN.

title: Mandi Price Volatility & Local Cold-Storage Spoilage Alert App for Smallholder Farmers
affected_group: Small and marginal vegetable growers deciding harvest timing and nearby mandi dispatch
summary: Combine historical Agmarknet mandi price trends with 7-day weather forecasts and shelf-life decay rules to recommend whether farmers should sell immediately, hold in ventilated storage, or pool transport.
context: Perishable crops like tomato, onion, and okra frequently suffer 20–30% distress price drops during local harvest gluts while nearby district mandis show shortages within the same week.
constraints: Must work on low-bandwidth Android browsers in regional languages (Tamil, Hindi, Telugu) and rely only on verifiable public price feeds plus simple farmer stock inputs.
feasibility_notes: Agmarknet historical commodity price CSVs and Open-Meteo weather APIs are free to query. A clean 36-hour MVP can forecast 7-day spread across 5 nearby mandis with SMS/WhatsApp summary export.

sources.name: Agmarknet Agricultural Marketing Data Portal
Open Government Data Platform India (Commodity Prices)

hints: Compare net price after transport cost per kilometer rather than showing raw mandi rates, otherwise farmers pick distant markets that lose money on freight.

previous_prototypes.prototype_summary: Static table displaying yesterday's mandi prices across India.
previous_prototypes.shortcoming: Ignored transport fuel cost, spoilage window, and local market arrival volume.

sample_solution_direction: FastAPI service ingesting Agmarknet historical CSVs + Prophet/XGBoost short-horizon forecast + mobile-first React net-profit calculator with freight deduction.

title: Soil Moisture & Root-Zone Salinity Telemetry for Precision Drip Irrigation Scheduling
affected_group: Semi-arid drip-irrigation farmers managing borewell depletion and soil salinization
summary: Build an affordable multi-depth capacitive soil moisture and EC salinity node that computes crop evapotranspiration deficits and prevents over-watering or fertilizer burn.
context: Fixed timer-based drip schedules waste 25–40% groundwater during cloudy or cool weeks while uneven fertigation causes root-zone salt buildup in cotton, banana, and turmeric belts.
constraints: Keep field node electronics under ₹1,500 using sealed capacitive probes (no bare resistive forks that corrode) and sleep current below 50 uA.
feasibility_notes: Demonstrable on a tabletop planter box with two capacitive moisture probes, an EC module, solenoid relay simulation, and a Flutter irrigation schedule timeline.

sources.name: FAO Irrigation & Drainage Paper 56 (Evapotranspiration Guidelines)

hints: Include soil-type calibration curves (sandy loam vs clay) and temperature compensation for EC readings; raw ADC voltages vary wildly across soil textures.

previous_prototypes.prototype_summary: Single FC-28 resistive sensor wired to Arduino turning a pump on below a hardcoded value.
previous_prototypes.shortcoming: Resistive probes corroded within weeks and no hysteresis or rain forecast check prevented pointless watering right before rainfall.

sample_solution_direction: ESP32 deep-sleep node with conformal-coated capacitive moisture probes + Penman-Monteith schedule adjustment served over FastAPI + Flutter valve override app.

title: Accessible Last-Mile Transit & Wheelchair-Friendly Route Companion for Tier-2 Cities
affected_group: Wheelchair users, elderly commuters, and visually impaired riders navigating city bus stops
summary: Create a crowdsourced accessibility layer over OpenStreetMap transit stops tracking curb ramps, tactile paving, step-free bus boarding, and audible stop announcements.
context: Standard map apps optimize purely for shortest driving or walking time, frequently routing wheelchair or crutch users onto broken footpaths, foot-overbridges with broken lifts, or uncurbed crossings.
constraints: Must provide screen-reader friendly controls (WCAG AA contrast, TalkBack/VoiceOver labels) and allow 2-tap community verification of ramp or elevator status.
feasibility_notes: OpenStreetMap Overpass API + OpenRouteService custom wheelchair profile make an immediate working prototype for any campus or city ward.

sources.name: Accessible India Campaign (Sugamya Bharat Abhiyan) Guidelines

hints: Focus on confidence scoring: an elevator marked working 6 months ago should decay in trust until another rider confirms it.

previous_prototypes.prototype_summary: Static pin map showing hospital locations without pedestrian path penalties.
previous_prototypes.shortcoming: Did not modify pedestrian graph edge weights, so turn-by-turn routes still sent users across inaccessible stairs.

sample_solution_direction: PostGIS pgRouting network weighted by OSM curb/incline tags + React Native VoiceOver-tested transit companion with freshness decay on ramp reports.

title: EV Two-Wheeler Battery Swap Demand & Feeder Grid Load Balancing Scheduler
affected_group: Gig-economy delivery riders, swap-station operators, and urban distribution utilities
summary: Predict hourly battery swap demand across city delivery hotspots and schedule smart off-peak charging at cabinets to reduce queue wait times and transformer peak load.
context: Food and parcel delivery riders face 20–40 minute queues during evening rush when cabinets run out of fully charged packs, while charging all depleted packs simultaneously stresses local feeders.
constraints: Charging plan must respect battery thermal recovery cooldown (15 minutes post-swap) and time-of-day tariff windows without leaving peak slots under-stocked.
feasibility_notes: Simulate city zones using OpenStreetMap delivery hubs and synthetic rider arrival curves; show interactive queue wait reduction vs naive charge-on-plug-in.

sources.name: NITI Aayog Battery Swapping Policy Draft Notes

hints: Present a clear before-vs-after metric: peak feeder kW drawdown and median rider wait minutes across simulated rush hours.

previous_prototypes.prototype_summary: Map showing static charging station addresses with hardcoded availability.
previous_prototypes.shortcoming: Had no demand forecast or charging-slot optimization logic.

sample_solution_direction: Linear/MILP charger slot scheduler in Python SciPy + demand heatmap UI in React showing cabinet SoC readiness over 24 hours.

title: Offline-First Antenatal & Immunization Follow-Up Assistant for Community Health Workers
affected_group: ASHA and Anganwadi health workers tracking maternal high-risk checkups in low-connectivity blocks
summary: Build a lightweight local-first mobile register that flags overdue antenatal visits, tracks hemoglobin/BP danger signs against protocol thresholds, and syncs incrementally over 2G.
context: Paper registers and heavy web portals lead to missed follow-ups for high-risk pregnancies and delayed pediatric immunization doses when mobile coverage drops inside rural villages.
constraints: Zero cloud dependency during field visits; encrypted local SQLite storage with PIN lock; clear color+icon risk cues (not color-only).
feasibility_notes: Publicly documented NHM immunization & ANC visit schedules provide exact ground-truth rule tables. Easy to demo offline toggle + conflict-free sync.

sources.name: National Health Mission (NHM) Maternal Health Guidelines

hints: Never claim medical diagnosis—frame risk flags strictly as rule-based screening alerts prompting doctor/PHC referral.

previous_prototypes.prototype_summary: Online-only React form storing unencrypted patient data in plain localStorage.
previous_prototypes.shortcoming: Failed completely offline and lacked privacy/access controls for sensitive health records.

sample_solution_direction: Flutter app with SQLCipher local database + delta sync queue to FastAPI + clear rule-based ANC/vaccine due calendar.

title: Smartphone Camera Physiotherapy Range-of-Motion & Exercise Form Tracker for Post-Fracture Rehab
affected_group: Outpatient physiotherapy patients recovering at home from knee, shoulder, or elbow injuries
summary: Use on-device pose estimation to measure joint flexion/extension angles in degrees, count valid repetitions, and export weekly progress charts for the supervising physiotherapist.
context: Patients often discontinue or perform home physiotherapy exercises incorrectly after hospital discharge because weekly clinic travel is costly and subjective self-logs are unreliable.
constraints: Must process frames client-side (no raw patient video uploaded to external servers). Handle side-view and front-view camera tolerances clearly.
feasibility_notes: MediaPipe Pose Landmarker runs smoothly in browser WebAssembly or Python at 25+ fps. Can be calibrated live during demo for knee extension and shoulder abduction.

sources.name: MediaPipe Pose Landmarker Technical Guide

hints: Smooth joint angle jitter using a 1-Euro or exponential moving average filter and detect incomplete reps cleanly.

previous_prototypes.prototype_summary: Streamed raw webcam video over WebSockets to a Python server for classification.
previous_prototypes.shortcoming: High latency (>800ms) and violated patient privacy expectations by transmitting home video.

sample_solution_direction: Browser-side MediaPipe Pose angle computation + smoothed rep state machine syncing only numeric JSON session summaries to FastAPI.

title: Solar Cold-Box Thermal Holdover & Compressor Scheduler for Village Milk Collection Centers
affected_group: Rural dairy cooperatives and horticulture collection centers experiencing daytime grid cuts
summary: Monitor phase-change thermal bank temperature, solar PV generation, and door-open events to run compressors preferentially during peak solar hours and alert staff before spoilage.
context: Raw milk must be chilled below 4–6 °C within hours of milking, yet rural collection centers rely on expensive diesel backup generators whenever afternoon feeder outages occur.
constraints: Retrofit onto existing chest chillers without voiding compressor warranty (non-invasive current clamp + DS18B20 probes + smart contactor).
feasibility_notes: Easily prototyped with a Peltier cooler box or relay lamp, 2 temperature probes, INA219 solar voltage/current sensor, and live thermal decay dashboard.

sources.name: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) Decentralized Cold Storage Briefs

hints: Track door-open duration and ambient temperature—frequent afternoon lid openings often cause more thermal loss than compressor sizing.

previous_prototypes.prototype_summary: Simple DHT11 thermometer sending alerts without solar forecast integration.
previous_prototypes.shortcoming: No pre-cooling logic before evening cloud cover or grid outage windows.

sample_solution_direction: ESP32 telemetry node + hysteresis-aware solar pre-cooling controller predicting hours of thermal holdover remaining.

title: Rapid State-of-Health Grader for Repurposing Retired EV Lithium Battery Modules
affected_group: Battery recyclers, campus microgrid labs, and second-life stationary storage integrators
summary: Measure short-pulse internal resistance and voltage relaxation curves across retired EV cells to cluster matched modules safe for low-rate solar storage.
context: EV packs are often retired at 70–80% remaining capacity, yet manual full charge-discharge cycling takes 8–12 hours per pack, stalling safe second-life sorting.
constraints: Keep test pulse under 10 minutes per module with hardware over-temperature/short-circuit cutoff and clear pass/quarantine safety flags.
feasibility_notes: NASA Prognostics Center and Oxford Battery Degradation datasets allow training/validating SOH regression models cleanly alongside a safe 18650 bench rig.

sources.name: NASA Ames Prognostics Battery Aging Dataset

hints: Emphasize cell-matching variance: pairing one weak high-resistance cell with healthy cells ruins the whole second-life string.

previous_prototypes.prototype_summary: Used open-circuit voltage alone to estimate battery health.
previous_prototypes.shortcoming: Resting voltage poorly reflects internal impedance fade or thermal runaway risk under load.

sample_solution_direction: Controlled MOSFET load pulse rig + voltage-recovery curve feature extraction in Python estimating SOH & pack-matching clusters.

title: Low-Cost Turbidity, pH & TDS Telemetry for Campus and Hostel Drinking Water Tanks
affected_group: College hostel residents, primary schools, and campus facility maintenance teams
summary: Deploy inline bypass sensor pods at overhead storage outlets to detect sudden turbidity spikes, RO membrane failure, or stagnant tank contamination before morning distribution.
context: Overhead tanks in hostels and schools often go months without cleaning or sensor checks, leading to seasonal waterborne illness outbreaks discovered only after students fall sick.
constraints: Keep total node cost under ₹2,000, separate electronics cleanly from wet chambers, and auto-calibrate drift against reference buffer checkpoints.
feasibility_notes: Gravity/analog turbidity, TDS, and pH probes interface directly with ESP32 ADC + clean React hostel-block maintenance dashboard.

sources.name: CPCB Drinking Water Quality Standards (BIS IS 10500 Summary)

hints: Wait for stable flow / pump-idle settling windows before logging turbidity, since air bubbles during tank refilling cause false turbidity spikes.

previous_prototypes.prototype_summary: Submerged unsealed breadboard sensors triggering continuous Slack alerts on bubble noise.
previous_prototypes.shortcoming: Biofouling and air-bubble artifacts caused uncalibrated drift within 48 hours.

sample_solution_direction: Bypass sampling tee with ESP32 median-filtered TDS/turbidity/pH readings + React alert dashboard tracking tank cleanings.

title: Stormwater Drain Siltation & Monsoon Flood Choke-Point Predictor Using Citizen Photos & DEM
affected_group: Municipal sanitation engineers, ward councilors, and low-lying neighborhood residents
summary: Combine elevation depression maps, rainfall intensity thresholds, and geotagged pre-monsoon citizen drain photos to prioritize desilting crews at high-impact choke points.
context: Urban flash flooding frequently stems not from river overflow alone, but from solid-waste-clogged stormwater culverts along low-lying road intersections.
constraints: Work with public SRTM/Cartosat elevation tiles and lightweight image classification so ward supervisors get ranked clearance lists before peak rain.
feasibility_notes: Public 30m DEM data + OpenStreetMap road topology allow computing flow-accumulation sinks for any Indian city ward in a weekend hackathon.

sources.name: NDMA Urban Flood Management Guidelines

hints: Combine topographic sink severity with downstream road traffic criticality so sanitation teams clear high-leverage culverts first.

previous_prototypes.prototype_summary: Generic pothole/garbage complaint portal with no drainage prioritization.
previous_prototypes.shortcoming: Created long unranked ticket backlogs indistinguishable from routine municipal complaints.

sample_solution_direction: DEM flow-accumulation sink overlay in PostGIS + FastAPI blockage severity scorer + before/after desilting verification map in React.

title: Interactive Tactile & Audio STEM Diagram Converter for Visually Impaired Students
affected_group: Blind and low-vision high school and engineering students reading textbook circuits, graphs, and biology diagrams
summary: Upload textbook photos of circuit schematics, bar charts, or geometric figures and generate structured audio walkthroughs plus embosser-ready SVG tactile layouts with Braille labels.
context: Screen readers handle plain text well, yet 80%+ of STEM textbook diagrams—free-body forces, logic gates, plots—remain inaccessible image blocks.
constraints: Export valid printable/swell-paper high-contrast SVG with Grade-1 Braille Unicode labels and keyboard-navigable node descriptions.
feasibility_notes: Focus reliably on one high-value diagram class first (e.g., line/bar charts + basic logic/circuit diagrams) rather than claiming universal diagram parsing.

sources.name: W3C Accessible SVG & Graphics Guidelines

hints: Keyboard arrow navigation across diagram nodes ('Resistor R1 connected between Node A and Ground') makes the web preview immediately testable without a Braille printer.

previous_prototypes.prototype_summary: Passed textbook images to a generic OCR reader.
previous_prototypes.shortcoming: OCR scrambled spatial labels without explaining connections, axes, or topological structure.

sample_solution_direction: OpenCV contour/component detector + graph topology extractor outputting accessible SVG + Web Speech API keyboard-explored audio tree.

title: Interactive Embedded & Digital Logic Lab Simulator with Stepwise Fault Diagnostics for Colleges
affected_group: First- and second-year ECE/CSE students at colleges with limited oscilloscope and hardware kit availability
summary: Provide a browser-based microcontroller GPIO, PWM, and sensor wiring sandbox that highlights common wiring bugs (floating inputs, missing pull-ups, reversed polarity) with guided hints.
context: Students in crowded lab batches often wait weeks for scarce lab benches or burn components due to basic wiring errors before learning conceptual timing and protocol debugging.
constraints: Run purely in the browser without requiring native desktop installs; include instructor-configurable fault-injection lab assignments.
feasibility_notes: Easy to scope around 5 core lab modules (LED PWM, UART serial framing, I2C address scan, ultrasonic timing, ADC voltage divider) with deterministic circuit rule checks.

sources.name: AICTE Model Curriculum Lab Modernization Notes

hints: Show an interactive logic-analyzer waveform view alongside the breadboard so students see baud mismatches and debounce bounce visually.

previous_prototypes.prototype_summary: Quiz app showing static circuit photos.
previous_prototypes.shortcoming: Offered no live pin-state simulation or diagnostic explanation when wires were misconnected.

sample_solution_direction: React SVG breadboard + deterministic node-netlist rule checker + real-time canvas waveform plotter.

title: On-Device UPI Payment Request, QR Code & SMS Phishing Risk Inspector for Elderly Users
affected_group: Senior citizens, small shopkeepers, and first-time digital payment users vulnerable to collect-request scams
summary: Inspect pasted SMS links, UPI intent URIs, and scanned QR payloads offline to explain in plain regional language whether a link actually sends money vs receives money or impersonates a bank domain.
context: Social-engineering frauds frequently trick victims into approving UPI 'Collect' requests or scanning tampered QR codes disguised as cashback or KYC refunds.
constraints: Zero uploading of personal SMS inbox history; explain specific red flags transparently (lookalike domains, `mode=collect` URI flags, urgency keywords) rather than opaque scores.
feasibility_notes: UPI deep-link URI specification parameters (`pa`, `pn`, `am`, `tr`, `mode`) and domain homoglyph/Levenshtein checks work deterministically offline in milliseconds.

sources.name: CERT-In & RBI Digital Payment Safety Advisories

hints: Make the warning screen unmistakable and jargon-free: 'Warning: Scanning this asks YOU to pay ₹4,999 — it does NOT credit cashback.'

previous_prototypes.prototype_summary: Required cloud API lookup for every SMS and showed technical regex errors.
previous_prototypes.shortcoming: Users could not understand the warning and sensitive bank SMS text left the phone.

sample_solution_direction: Flutter QR/URI parser + Punycode/homoglyph domain similarity check + bilingual voice readout warning before opening any payment app.

title: LoRa Offline Mesh SOS Beacon & Relief Resource Triage Map for Post-Cyclone Blackout Zones
affected_group: Coastal panchayats, cyclone shelters, and first-responder volunteers during cellular and power outages
summary: Create battery-backed LoRa relay nodes paired with smartphone BLE apps so stranded households can broadcast compact GPS + medical/water triage packets across multi-hop mesh links to district command posts.
context: Major coastal cyclones regularly knock out grid power and cell towers for 48–96 hours, leaving relief coordinators blind to isolated wards needing insulin, drinking water, or generator fuel.
constraints: Keep SOS payload under 48 bytes for long-range LoRa spreading factors; enforce deduplication TTL hops so mesh traffic does not flood.
feasibility_notes: Demonstrable live using two Heltec/TTGO ESP32 LoRa boards (or serial-simulated relay) feeding an offline Leaflet/MBTiles command map.

sources.name: NDMA National Cyclone Risk Mitigation Documentation

hints: Highlight compact binary packet encoding (lat/lon quantized + urgency bitmask) and store-and-forward acknowledgment so survivors know their SOS reached a relay.

previous_prototypes.prototype_summary: Wi-Fi chat app assuming internet access to load Google Maps tiles.
previous_prototypes.shortcoming: Blank map screen when offline and <80m Wi-Fi range failed across flooded streets.

sample_solution_direction: ESP32 + SX1278/SX1262 LoRa compact binary mesh relay with BLE phone bridge + cached MBTiles Flutter triage map.
